$comment: Machine-readable client matrix: which client apps understand the AmneziaWG 3.1 profile, on what basis that is known and when it was checked. The tables in ADVANCED.md and ADVANCED.en.md are rendered from this file by scripts/update-client-tables.sh and are not edited by hand. Text fields (name, version, since, since_note, where) are either one language-neutral string or an object with exactly ru and en. Dates are YYYY-MM-DD; checked_at may be at most one day ahead of the UTC date. freshness_days is 1 to 90.
freshness_rule: every checked_at must be at most freshness_days before the release date of the current SCRIPT_VERSION in CHANGELOG.md; the date comes from the repository, not from a clock, so the check fails when a release is prepared on a stale table and not on an ordinary day

support_values.yes: the released app understands the 3.1 profile
support_values.dev-channel: only in a development or pre-release channel
support_values.unknown: we do not know; such a row must not name a generation, so it has no since, since_date or since_note

basis_values.verified-behaviour: tested on a generated 3.1 profile; evidence needs version and env
basis_values.build-pin: read in the project code at a fixed ref; evidence needs ref
basis_values.vendor-docs: the project's release notes, store page or docs; evidence needs url
basis_values.inference-from-dates: inferred from release dates; evidence needs url
basis_values.unknown: no basis; support must be unknown
